backend/main.mo: Defines all backend Motoko types for patients, labs, medications, ADRs, prescribers, restricted drugs, interactions, external resources, and narrations, with storage mixin and imports.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence metadata mapping features to related frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides prewritten summaries for many frontend files describing their roles and recent behavior changes.
frontend/.env.local: Local development environment variables including network, canister IDs, host, and port settings.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app logic managing authentication, profile loading behavior, delayed recovery banner, layout, and query client setup.
frontend/src/backend.idl.ts: IDL definitions mapping backend Motoko types and service interface for frontend canister interactions.
frontend/src/components/AddPatientDialog: React dialog component for adding a patient with validation, memoized fields, BMI calculation, and accessibility features.
frontend/src/components/AdrForm.tsx: Form component for submitting ADRs with validation, date parsing, and success/error handling.
frontend/src/components/AdrsModule.tsx: Displays patient details and tabs for recording and viewing ADRs filtered for a specific patient.
frontend/src/components/CaseEntry.tsx: Main case entry interface showing patient info and tabs for lab results, medications, ADRs, prescriber details, and summary.
frontend/src/components/CaseSummary.tsx: Aggregates all patient-related data into a detailed case summary with export functionality.
frontend/src/components/DisclaimersSecti: Renders static disclaimer messages with contextual icons in a styled card.
frontend/src/components/DrugDetailsModal: Modal displaying detailed drug information with fallback handling and status indicators.
frontend/src/components/DrugDrugInteract: Provides a searchable UI for drug interaction data, handling drug selection, manual lookup, and monograph viewing.
frontend/src/components/DrugInteractions: Checks and displays drug–drug, drug–food, and food–food interactions with severity, evidence, and summary details.
frontend/src/components/DrugMonographSec: Renders pharmacokinetic and clinical monograph details for a drug or a fallback message if unavailable.
Displays a filterable, paginated drug table with status tabs, category filters, and data refresh and verification tools.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the application footer with branding and an academic‑use disclaimer.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Shows the top navigation bar with logo, user profile info, and logout functionality when authenticated.
frontend/src/components/LabResultsForm.t: Captures and validates lab result inputs and submits them with error handling and success feedback.
frontend/src/components/LabResultsModule: Displays patient info, BMI category, a form for entering lab results, and a tabbed list of the patient’s recorded lab results.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Handles Internet Identity login with logo preloading, error handling, and a secure-access UI card.
frontend/src/components/MedicationForm.t: Provides a validated form for adding patient medications, including date parsing, error feedback, and mutation submission.
frontend/src/components/MedicationsModul: Shows patient details, BMI category, a medication entry form, and a tabbed medication history list.
frontend/src/components/MonthlyBanTrends: Computes yearly drug-ban statistics and displays them in a dialog with summary cards and a bar chart.
frontend/src/components/NameAutocomplete: Implements an input with filtered name suggestions, keyboard navigation, and click‑outside handling.
frontend/src/components/PatientDetailsDi: Displays a dialog with detailed patient info including labs, medications, and ADRs, using memoized components and filtered query data.
frontend/src/components/PatientManagemen: Provides a patient list with actions for viewing details, selecting, adding, and deleting patients, using memoized rows and query hooks.
frontend/src/components/PreclinicalDataF: Empty placeholder file for a preclinical data form component.
frontend/src/components/PreclinicalDataM: Empty placeholder file for a preclinical data module component.
frontend/src/components/PrescriberDetail: Form for viewing and editing prescriber details with validation, loading existing data, and saving via mutation.
frontend/src/components/PrescriptionUplo: Empty placeholder file for a prescription upload component.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal for initial user profile setup with validation, input focus management, and save-profile mutation.
frontend/src/components/RestrictedDrugsM: Displays searchable restricted drug categories and external resources, with collapsible sections and detailed drug info.
frontend/src/components/StartupProfileRe: Shows a banner when profile loading is delayed, offering retry and logout actions.
frontend/src/components/WavebotWidget.ts: React chat widget component integrating patient and lab data queries and predefined external resources, managing messages and UI state.
frontend/src/data/curatedDrugDataset.ts: Provides a large curated drug dataset with normalization and deduplication utilities prioritizing banned drugs and newer records.
frontend/src/data/drugFoodInteractionsDa: Defines structured drug–food interaction entries with clinical effects, risk levels, and management recommendations.
frontend/src/data/drugInteractionExample: Contains preset drug interaction example sets and utility functions to load and validate them.
Comprehensive drug monograph dataset including pharmacokinetics, side effects, contraindications, and special population guidance.
frontend/src/data/foodFoodInteractionsDa: Dataset of food–food interaction pairs with severity, clinical effects, and recommended management.
frontend/src/data/foodList.ts: Canonical list of food names for autocomplete and interaction lookup, plus a helper to return the full list.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating patient, lab, medication, and interaction data using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets global Tailwind-based styles, theme variables, dark mode rules, and optimized animation and GPU-acceleration utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering the root component.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Implements the main dashboard with tab navigation, lazy-loaded modules, prefetching logic, and patient/module state management.
frontend/src/services/cdscoDrugService.t: Simulates a CDSCO drug data service with cached fetching of banned drug information for client-side use.
frontend/src/services/drugDrugInteractio: Manages cached drug-drug interaction data with fallback defaults and daily sync handling.
frontend/src/services/drugInteractionInd: Builds and caches a normalized O(1) lookup index for drug-drug interactions.
frontend/src/services/drugInteractionVer: Loads, caches, and syncs verified interaction data from external sources like MIMS India and Toaz Info.
frontend/src/services/drugListVerificati: Validates a drug list for empty names, invalid statuses, and duplicates, returning a structured report.
frontend/src/services/drugMonographServi: Provides normalization-aware lookup and caching of drug monograph data.
frontend/src/services/foodInteractionInd: Builds and caches lookup indexes for drug-food and food-food interactions using normalized keys.
frontend/src/services/interactionNameCat: Generates normalized drug and food suggestion lists and filters them based on user input.
frontend/src/services/localInteractionCh: Computes drug-drug, drug-food, and food-food interactions using cached indexes and normalized pairing.
frontend/src/services/multiSourceDrugSer: Service that loads, caches, merges, and periodically syncs multi‑source drug data with deterministic deduplication and scheduled background updates.
frontend/src/utils/dateParsing.ts: Utilities for validating, parsing, and formatting dates as nanosecond timestamps.
frontend/src/utils/drugPairs.ts: Helpers for normalizing drug names, generating unique drug pairs, comparing pairs, and creating display labels.
frontend/src/utils/formValidation.ts: Shared validation utilities for required fields, email, contact numbers, numeric inputs, and detecting first invalid fields.
frontend/src/utils/interactionSummary.ts: Computes overall interaction summaries including highest severity, toxicity risk, and recommendations, and formats severity/risk labels.
frontend/src/utils/nameNormalization.ts: Functions to normalize names, compare them, and detect duplicates ignoring case, spacing, and punctuation.
frontend/src/utils/namePairs.ts: Generates unique name pairs and formats combined pair labels.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration with custom colors, themes, plugins, and container settings.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, existing features, and pending feature requests for a healthcare/patient registry application, including prescriber details and drug dataset updates.
